note: Single menu contract for the homepage, the Agent app and all generated pages. footer_groups only REFERENCE the drawer entries (home, agent, drawer groups), so header, sidebar and footer share one vocabulary. Every published parent hub, category, available subtopic and static Page is linked with 2–3 word navigation labels; SEO titles and URL slugs never change.

drawer.note: The ONE sidebar (v79): a left off-canvas panel on phones/tablets, an in-flow collapsible left column on desktop content pages, an overlay in the Agent app. Order: Trang Chủ, Hỏi Agent, then the groups below, then the theme row. Cẩm Nang resolves hubs > canonical categories > non-empty subtopics from data/blog/taxonomy.json (nested accordions, every level a real link) and its url is the blog home (the one key for that URL: header, Tìm Bài, footer and breadcrumbs read it; the builder writes that page at blog/index.html); Trang Web lists the config/site-pages.json pages without a group; Pháp Lý lists the pages with "group": "legal" (same registry, same order); Dịch Vụ has verified contact actions. "collapsed": true renders a group closed until the reader opens it (the group of the current page always opens). Agent chat keeps its reset control.

chat_extras.note: Chat-homepage-only utility appended AFTER the core drawer: a divider + the reset action. Never rendered on content pages.

svg_icons.note: Inline SVG icon names (tools/blog-components.mjs ICON_PATHS) for the menus: the desktop top level (>= 1360px) and the sidebar's top level, groups and hubs. Categories and subtopics are text only.
